children: Turkey's central bank bought about $10 billion in foreign currency this week, after selling around $9.5 billion in September amid market turmoil linked to a recent crisis in the investment fund sector, traders said on Friday.

Calculations by three traders based on the central bank's daily balance sheet and preliminary data showed the bank purchased at least $9 billion in the first four days of the week, with purchases continuing and likely reaching $10 billion for the week.
The central bank declined to comment.
